In seven-dimensional [[geometry]], a '''truncated 7-orthoplex''' is a convex [[uniform 7-polytope]], being a [[Truncation (geometry)|truncation]] of the regular [[7-orthoplex]].

There are 6 truncations of the 7-orthoplex. Vertices of the truncation 7-orthoplex are located as pairs on the edge of the 7-orthoplex. Vertices of the bitruncated 7-orthoplex are located on the triangular faces of the 7-orthoplex. Vertices of the tritruncated 7-orthoplex are located inside the [[tetrahedron|tetrahedral]] cells of the 7-orthoplex. The final three truncations are best expressed relative to the 7-cube.

=== Alternate names ===
* Truncated heptacross
* Truncated hecatonicosaoctaexon (Jonathan Bowers){{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/taz.htm (x3x3o3o3o3o4o - taz)]}}

=== Coordinates ===
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the vertices of a truncated 7-orthoplex, centered at the origin, are all 168 vertices are sign (4) and coordinate (42) [[permutation]]s of
: (±2,±1,0,0,0,0,0)

=== Images ===
{{7-cube Coxeter plane graphs|t56|120}}

=== Construction ===
There are two [[Coxeter group]]s associated with the ''truncated 7-orthoplex'', one with the C<sub>7</sub> or [4,3<sup>5</sup>] Coxeter group, and a lower symmetry with the D<sub>7</sub> or [3<sup>4,1,1</sup>] Coxeter group.
